lines.japanese: そんなわけで、俺たちはいま猛スピードで柳木原から遠ざかっている。
lines.english: And that was why we were now speeding away from Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: 紫色の煙に包まれた街を離れて、健康な青い空の下へ。たまにはそういうのも嫌いじゃない。
lines.english: We left the city wreathed in purple smoke and emerged beneath a healthy blue sky. I didn’t mind doing that once in a while.

lines.japanese: そう、嫌いじゃないんだが……。
lines.english: No, I didn’t mind it, but...

lines.japanese: 「うはー、見てください外ー。もうすっかり旅先夢気分ー」
lines.english: “Whoa, look outside! It already feels like we’ve traveled into a dream!”

lines.japanese: 「おい。危ねーから外に顔だすな。小学校のころ先生から習っただろ」
lines.english: “Hey. Don’t stick your head out. It’s dangerous. Your teacher taught you that in elementary school.”

lines.japanese: 鳴に窓際の席を譲ったのは失敗だっただろうか。やつが望むと思って通路側の席を選んだら、案の定となりで大騒ぎしていた。
lines.english: Had giving Naru the window seat been a mistake? I’d taken the aisle, figuring she’d want the window, and sure enough, she was making a huge commotion beside me.

lines.japanese: 「あー！　見てくださいほらー、木ー！」
lines.english: “Ah! Look, Hayato! Trees!”

lines.japanese: 「木かよ。木は柳木原にもあんだろ」
lines.english: “Trees? We’ve got trees in Yanagihara.”

lines.japanese: 「ああー！　おばさんが犬つれて歩いてるー！」
lines.english: “Ahhh! A lady’s walking her dog!”

lines.japanese: 「つうかあの、おまえん中でここどこなんだよ。宇宙か」
lines.english: “Okay, where exactly do you think we are? Outer space?”

lines.japanese: 「いやー、こんなのどかな風景の中で食べる駅弁は、また格別なおいひはへふほへー」
lines.english: “Wow, a boxed lunch with scenery this peaceful tastes efpecially delifious.”

lines.japanese: 「あんさ、しゃべってる途中で口の中にもの入れるのやめてくんない。小学校のころ先生から習っただろ」
lines.english: “Could you stop putting food in your mouth halfway through a sentence? Your teacher taught you that in elementary school too.”

lines.japanese: やつは一々ツッコミを入れる俺に対して、不服そうに口を尖らせた。
lines.english: She pouted, apparently dissatisfied with my constant retorts.

lines.japanese: 「隼人さん、ハッスル足りないんじゃないですかー。せっかくの旅行ですよー」
lines.english: “You’re not showing enough spirit, Hayato. We’re on vacation!”

lines.japanese: 「いや、まあ、俺も充分ハッスルはしてるんだけど。駅弁三回目だし」
lines.english: “No, I’ve got plenty of spirit. This is my third station lunch.”

lines.japanese: しかも、俺は鳴が半分も食べない内に食いおわっていた。さっきやつも言っていたが、旅先での駅弁は格別に美味い。
lines.english: What’s more, I had finished mine before Naru had eaten half of hers. She was right about one thing: station lunches really did taste better when you were traveling.

lines.japanese: 「ただなあ、あんまり騒ぎすぎっと、ガキじゃねんだから恥ずかし……」
lines.english: “But if you make too much noise, it’s embarrassing. You’re not a little kid...”

lines.japanese: 「あれ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 通路に身を乗りだして前後を見わたすと、俺たち以外に乗客は一人も居なかった。
lines.english: I leaned into the aisle and looked both ways. There was not a single passenger in the car besides us.

lines.japanese: 「なんだこりゃ。この車両、俺たちの貸し切りか」
lines.english: “What the hell? Did we get a private car?”

lines.japanese: 「はー、けっこう有名な温泉地なのに、意外とお客さん少ないんですねー」
lines.english: “Huh. This is a pretty famous hot-spring town, but there are surprisingly few passengers.”

lines.japanese: やつはウインナー片手にガイドブックをぱらぱらめくる。俺が用意したものじゃない。数日前に、自前で購入してきたものらしい。
lines.english: She flipped through a guidebook with a sausage in one hand. It was not the one I had prepared. Apparently she had bought her own a few days earlier.

lines.japanese: 「たまたまそういう時間に当たったのかもな」
lines.english: “Maybe we just happened to catch it at a quiet time.”

lines.japanese: 「そうかもしれませんねー。やーん、二人のための列車ー、専用車両ー」
lines.english: “Maybe. Ooh, a train just for the two of us! Our own private car!”

lines.japanese: 鳴の頭が横に動き、こつんこつんと俺の肩を小突く。
lines.english: Naru leaned sideways and gently bumped her head against my shoulder again and again.

lines.japanese: 「ふん」
lines.english: “Hmph.”

lines.japanese: まあ、そういうことなら。
lines.english: Well, if that was how it was.

lines.japanese: 「よっ」
lines.english: “Come here.”

lines.japanese: 「へっ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 俺は抱えこむように腕を回して、やつの脇腹へ手を回した。
lines.english: I wrapped an arm around her, almost scooping her up, and placed my hand against her side.

lines.japanese: 「あっ、あれー？」
lines.english: “Wh-what’s this?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人さん、恥ずかしいんじゃなかったんですかー？」
lines.english: “I thought you said you were embarrassed, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「まあ、誰もいないみたいだし？」
lines.english: “Well, looks like nobody’s here.”

lines.japanese: 自分から誘ったんだ。くっつくこと自体が嫌なわけじゃない。
lines.english: I was the one who’d invited her along. It wasn’t like I minded cuddling up to her.

lines.japanese: 「ハードボイルドが崩れるし、あんま馬鹿ップルみてーな真似はしたくねーけど……」
lines.english: “It’d ruin my hard-boiled image, so I don’t wanna act like some idiot couple all the time...”

lines.japanese: 「け、けど？」
lines.english: “B-but?”

lines.japanese: 「まあ俺もまだ若いからな」
lines.english: “But I’m still young too.”

lines.japanese: たまには。と添えて、鳴の体をぐっと引きよせた。
lines.english: “Once in a while,” I added, pulling Naru firmly against me.

lines.japanese: 「あ、はー……あはは、なんだかこんなところだと、ちょっと照れてしまいますなー」
lines.english: “Ah, wow... Ahaha. Doing this here is actually a little embarrassing.”

lines.japanese: 鳴は小さな頬をほんのりと赤く染めた。
lines.english: A faint blush colored Naru’s small cheeks.

lines.japanese: 「なんていうか私、こういうのちょっと憧れてたんですよねー。普通の家庭なら旅行とか小さい頃にするのかもしれませんけど、父の仕事が忙しかったから、そういう機会も滅多にありませんでしたしー」
lines.english: “I guess I always dreamed of something like this. Normal families might take trips when the children are little, but Father was so busy with work that we hardly ever had the chance.”

lines.japanese: 「だからこうやって隼人さんに誘ってもらえて、私、本当に嬉ひうふぁー、ほほういんはーおいひーい」
lines.english: “So having you invite me like this really makes me sho happy—ooh, thifh ish delicious!”

lines.japanese: 「ちょー、おまえさ。いまちょっと感動的なこと言いかけたのに、切れ目なく話題変えんのやめてくんない。それと、しゃべってる途中で口にもの入れるのもやめてくんない」
lines.english: “Hey, come on. You were saying something kinda moving, then changed the subject without even pausing. And stop putting food in your mouth in the middle of a sentence.”

lines.japanese: ちっ、たまに甘い方向性を目指してみればこれだ。
lines.english: Tch. This was what I got for trying to steer things in a sweet direction for once.

lines.japanese: やっぱ俺のキャラとは違うわな。はあ、あほらし……。
lines.english: It just wasn’t in character for me. God, how stupid...

lines.japanese: 「あ、ところで隼人さん。もう食べちゃったなら、私のお弁当少しいりますー？」
lines.english: “Oh, by the way, Hayato. If you’re already done, would you like some of my lunch?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　さっき食ったばっかりだし、べつにいらね……」
lines.english: “Huh? I just ate. I don’t need—”

lines.japanese: ふと隣を見ると、鳴はウインナーを食べているところだった。
lines.english: I glanced beside me and found Naru eating a sausage.

lines.japanese: が、そこで驚くべきものを見た。鳴がウインナーを咥えながらちゅぱちゅぱと音を立てていた。
lines.english: But then I saw something startling. With the sausage between her lips, Naru was making wet sucking noises.

lines.japanese: 「あ、あれ？」
lines.english: “Uh... Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「はいー？」
lines.english: “Yes?”

lines.japanese: なにしてんだこいつ……もしかして、いつだったかフェラの練習にウインナー使ったときの癖がまだ抜けてねーのか。
lines.english: What was she doing...? Had she still not broken the habit from that time she used a sausage to practice giving head?

lines.japanese: 鳴はしばらくその行為を続けてからウインナーを噛みきり、もぐもぐと咀嚼したものを喉の奥へ下していった。
lines.english: Naru continued for a while, then bit through the sausage, chewed the piece in her mouth, and swallowed it down.

lines.japanese: な、なんかエロいじゃねえかコノヤロウ……。
lines.english: D-damn it, that was kinda hot...

lines.japanese: 俺はもう一度、後部座席を振りかえった。やはり車内には俺たちしかいない。
lines.english: I looked back at the seats behind us once more. We were still the only ones in the car.

lines.japanese: 鳴は三本目のウインナーへ入っていた。またしても隣からちゅぱちゅぱ音が聞こえてくる。
lines.english: Naru started on her third sausage. Once again, wet sucking noises came from beside me.

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴の腰へ当てた手を、すすすと静かに下ろしていった。
lines.english: I slowly, silently lowered the hand resting on Naru’s waist.

lines.japanese: 「いやでもほんと。マジで気持ちよかった」
lines.english: “But seriously. That felt amazing.”

lines.japanese: 「とはいえ、やっぱどっかしらセーブしてる感はあったわな。うん、やっぱ場所のせいか」
lines.english: “Still, I definitely felt like I was holding something back. Yeah, must’ve been the location.”

lines.japanese: 「え、どこがセーブしてたんだこのひとー……って、そーですよ！　やっぱり普通がいいと思います、そうしましょう、今後はそうしましょう」
lines.english: “What part of that was holding back...? Exactly! Normal is best. Let’s stick to normal from now on.”

lines.japanese: まだ息を見出しつつ、鳴は強くアブノーマルの否定を訴えた。ま、俺もこんなのは一年に一回くらいでいい。
lines.english: Still breathing unevenly, Naru forcefully rejected anything abnormal. Well, once a year was probably enough for me too.

lines.japanese: 「だな。やっぱ終わったあとに二人で寝らんねーのも辛いしな」
lines.english: “Yeah. And it sucks not being able to sleep together afterward.”

lines.japanese: 「はいっ、はいっ。そーですよー、最初から気付いてくださいよ、もー」
lines.english: “Yes! Exactly! You should have realized that from the start. Honestly.”

lines.japanese: 「はっはっは」
lines.english: “Hahaha.”

lines.japanese: 俺は鳴の頭をぐりぐりと撫でた。
lines.english: I vigorously ruffled Naru’s hair.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ続きは旅館ついてから、温泉の中でだな」
lines.english: “Then we’ll continue in the hot spring after we reach the inn.”

lines.japanese: 「屋外禁止ー！」
lines.english: “No doing it outdoors!”

lines.japanese: 俺はツッコまれた。
lines.english: She shot me down.

lines.japanese: 「え、じゃあ、部屋の風呂ならいいの」
lines.english: “What, so the bath in our room is fine?”

lines.japanese: 「ケダモノー！」
lines.english: “You animal!”

lines.japanese: 俺は駅に着くまでツッコまれ続けた。
lines.english: She kept shooting me down until we reached the station.
